summary.text: Charity Martin King is the Democratic candidate for Ohio House of Representatives District 2 in the November 3, 2026 general election, an open seat with no incumbent.
Her career experience includes work as a director in higher education, outreach and workforce development.

paragraphs.text: Charity Martin King graduated from Eastmoor High School and earned a graduate degree from The Ohio State University.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she described more than 30 years of experience designing, managing and scaling programs and businesses across education, workforce development, nonprofit leadership, social enterprise and civic engagement.
Martin King advanced from the Democratic primary on May 5, 2026.
She listed housing innovation, energy and sustainability, and fair wages and worker protection as her three key campaign messages.
Her survey also names workforce and economic opportunity, family stability and responsible governance among her policy priorities.
